facts.text: The guards watching want another slice.
facts.why: In the last lines one security guard asks 'You want another slice?' and the other says 'No, I'm OK.' Only one guard offers, and the other turns it down.
facts.fix: A guard offers another slice as the show ends.
facts.applied_text: A guard offers another slice at the end. Crisp tray pizza with pepperoni and mozzarella.

facts.why: Printed as a date stamp on the TV still. The film never gives a date or year for the broadcast (the show runs about 30 years, day 10,909 on the screen), so 26 October 1998 is an invented date tied to the release year, not the story.

notes: Writer's doubt settled: Meryl's Mococoa line 'All natural cocoa beans from the upper slopes of Mount Nicaragua' confirmed on moviequotes.com, so 'Mount Nicaragua Mococoa pots' is ok. 'Meryl made macaroni' rests on one blog (Erica Huff) and is an unquoted nod; left ok. Note quote, tagline, Marlon's beer, Cue the sun, Fiji, the bus and the falling light all match Wikiquote and Wikipedia. The TV still does not repeat the mosaic poster.

vibe.verdict: Truman and Meryl's kitchen with Mococoa, Marlon's beer and Cue the sun feels right, but the food is mostly plain and some big moments are missing.
missing: Meryl's kitchen gadget: 'What are you gonna do? Slice me, dice me or peel me?' (the knife fight)
'Somebody help me, I'm being spontaneous!' (Truman tries to leave)
Marlon on the bridge: 'the last thing I would ever do is lie to you' (fed lines by Christof)
Christof: 'He was born in front of a live audience.' (the storm)
Truman's bow at the exit door
ideas: Swap the macaroni note 'Meryl made macaroni.' for 'Slice me, dice me or peel me?' (Truman, as Meryl backs off with a kitchen tool).
Swap the fish pie note 'Truman sails into the painted sky.' for 'Is that the best you can do? You're gonna have to kill me!' cut to 'Is that the best you can do?'
Swap the muffins note 'And in case I don't see ya.' for 'Somebody help me, I'm being spontaneous!'
Give the fish pie its food line on the card ('Snapper pie under buttery mash' prints cut to 'Snapper pie.').
changed: Recipe card head now prints 'DAY 10,909' in place of 1998 (new optional flavour stamp, also drives the TV still stamp)
